def test_user_add_address_and_card():
    username, _, _ = create_user()

    addr_payload = {"city": "London", "country": "UK", "number": "10", "postcode": "SW1", "street": "Baker St", "userID": username}
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/addresses"), json=addr_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    addr_id = resp.json().get("id")
    assert addr_id is not None

    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/addresses/{addr_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    addr_data = resp.json()
    assert addr_data["city"] == addr_payload["city"]
    assert addr_data["country"] == addr_payload["country"]
    assert addr_data["street"] == addr_payload["street"]

    card_payload = {"ccv": "123", "expires": "12/25", "longNum": "1234567890123456", "userID": username}
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/cards"), json=card_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    card_id = resp.json().get("id")
    assert card_id is not None

    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/cards/{card_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    card_data = resp.json()
    assert card_data["ccv"] == card_payload["ccv"]
    assert card_data["expires"] == card_payload["expires"]
    assert card_data["longNum"].endswith("3456")

def test_carts_add_and_delete_item():
    username, _, _ = create_user()

    resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", "/catalogue"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    item = resp.json()[0]
    item_id = item["id"]
    price = item["price"]

    cart_payload = {"itemId": item_id, "quantity": 2, "unitPrice": price}
    resp = requests.post(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{username}/items"), json=cart_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 201, f"Expected 201, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{username}/items"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    items = resp.json()
    assert len(items) == 1
    assert items[0]["itemId"] == item_id
    assert items[0]["quantity"] == 2

    resp = requests.delete(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{username}/items/{item_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 202, f"Expected 202, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{username}/items/{item_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 404, f"Expected 404, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

def test_orders_place_order_success():
    username, _, _ = create_user()

    addr_payload = {"city": "London", "country": "UK", "number": "10", "postcode": "SW1", "street": "Baker St", "userID": username}
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/addresses"), json=addr_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    addr_id = resp.json()["id"]

    card_payload = {"ccv": "123", "expires": "12/25", "longNum": "1234567890123456", "userID": username}
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/cards"), json=card_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    card_id = resp.json()["id"]

    resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", "/catalogue"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    item = resp.json()[0]

    cart_payload = {"itemId": item["id"], "quantity": 1, "unitPrice": 10.0}
    resp = requests.post(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{username}/items"), json=cart_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 201, f"Expected 201, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    order_payload = {
        "customer": f"/customers/{username}",
        "address": f"/addresses/{addr_id}",
        "card": f"/cards/{card_id}",
        "items": f"/carts/{username}/items"
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("orders", "/orders"), json=order_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 201, f"Expected 201, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    order_data = resp.json()
    order_id = order_data["id"]
    assert order_data["payment"]["authorised"] is True

    resp = requests.get(get_url("orders", f"/orders/{order_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json()["id"] == order_id

def test_payment_authorize():
    order_id = create_full_order()

    payment_payload = {
        "address": {"city": "London", "country": "UK", "number": "10", "postcode": "SW1", "street": "Baker St"},
        "amount": 50.0,
        "card": {"ccv": "123", "expires": "12/25", "longNum": "1234567890123456"},

        "orderId": order_id
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("payment-http", "/payments"), json=payment_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    auth_data = resp.json()
    assert auth_data["authorised"] is True
    assert auth_data["orderId"] == order_id

    resp = requests.get(get_url("payment-http", f"/payments/{order_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    auths = resp.json()
    assert len(auths) > 0
    assert auths[0]["orderId"] == order_id
